entries.o: <fe><02><0a><31><32><33><62><5f><30><30><34><33><00>Remember to check any\nnew items you get!
<fe><02><0a><31><32><33><62><5f><30><30><34><34><00>Did a pillar fall?\nThis place is dangerous...
<fe><02><0a><31><32><34><61><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Man, Heaven's Gate is\nbigger than I thought.

<fe><02><0a><31><32><34><61><5f><30><30><30><38><00>With all that sand inside,
it must be pretty old.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><32><34><61><5f><30><30><30><39><00>What a bummer...
There's no treasure.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><32><34><61><5f><30><30><31><30><00>Wouldn't it be nice if
every chest had something?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><32><34><61><5f><30><30><31><31><00>I should warn you,
though...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><32><34><61><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Some chests may have traps
inside, so be careful.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>The path to Riviera seems\nto be in disrepair.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Higher... and higher...\nI'm starting to feel faint.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>If you're just gonna\ncomplain, why'd you come?
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>There's one thing I forgot\nto mention...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>You must fill your \nOver Drive meter first.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>So I can't just use it\nwhenever I want?
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>Also, the meter is shared,\nso don't be selfish.

<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>It builds as we are hit\nand as we hit our foes.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>Don't hesitate to use it.\nIt'll be wasted if we lose.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>I'll definitely use it\nwhen I get the chance.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>Show them the power of\na Grim Angel, Ein!
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>Yep. The higher the level,\nthe more the meter drops.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><37><00>My Over Skill only lowers\nit 1 tier, right?
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>And in my case, the meter\ncompletely shatters.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><33><30><00>You ended up not using your\nOver Skill, huh?
<fe><02><0a><31><33><33><62><5f><30><30><33><36><00>Each of our Over Skills\nhas its advantages.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><34><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>The enemy has noticed us.\nIt doesn't matter now.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><33><34><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>I intended to defeat them\nanyways.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><34><62><5f><30><30><32><39><00>The enemy noticed us.\nIt doesn't matter now.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><33><34><62><5f><30><30><33><30><00>I intended to defeat them\nanyways.
<fe><02><0a><31><33><34><62><5f><30><30><33><32><00>There may be other demons\nnearby, so be ready.
<fe><02><0a><31><34><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>More climbing? We must\nstill have a ways to go.

<fe><02><0a><31><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>The ancient power must be\nawakened to save Asgard,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>but Riviera might be\ndestroyed in the process.
<fe><02><0a><31><34><33><62><5f><30><30><34><32><00>There's only one place\nthe light doesn't shine.
<fe><02><0a><31><34><34><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Ein, concentrate on\ncompleting the mission.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><34><34><62><5f><30><30><31><36><00>We must fulfill our duty.\nGot it?
<fe><02><0a><31><34><34><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>The step looks like it's\ngoing to crumble.
<fe><02><0a><31><34><34><62><5f><30><30><32><32><00>Um, you might wanna worry\nabout that boulder first!
<fe><02><0a><31><35><33><61><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Once we jump off, we\nwon't be coming back.

<fe><02><0a><31><35><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Whew. A safe landing.\nNow, where are we?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><35><33><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>...I hope those chains are\nas strong as they look.
<fe><02><0a><31><35><33><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>It seems we're being\ntaken to the bottom.
<fe><02><0a><31><35><33><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>I saw a ledge we could\nhave jumped to.
<fe><02><0a><31><36><32><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Yeah, flying's not much fun\nfor an angel without wings.
<fe><02><0a><31><36><32><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>The creaking of those\nchains is kinda creepy.
<fe><02><0a><31><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>You look kinda pale, Ein...\nTry not to lose your lunch.
<fe><02><0a><31><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>At least I won't be\ncoughing up any hairballs!
<fe><02><0a><31><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>There's something stuck\nin one of the links.
<fe><02><0a><31><36><34><61><5f><30><30><30><37><00>A Fire Orb! It'll raise\nyour resistance to fire.
<fe><02><0a><31><36><34><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Do you think we'll run\ninto any more demons?
<fe><02><0a><31><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I can't believe all this\nis Heaven's Gate.
<fe><02><0a><31><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Yes. This is only\na small portion of it.
<fe><02><0a><31><37><32><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>In that case, maybe I\nshould let you open 'em.
<fe><02><0a><31><37><32><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>Just be ready to run\nwhen you open one.
<fe><02><0a><31><37><32><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>Smart thinkin'. Not all\nchests are safe to open.
<fe><02><0a><31><37><34><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>We're very close...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><37><34><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>But there should be some kind\nof barrier preventing entry.
<fe><02><0a><31><37><34><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Of course not! I'm\na Fairy. My name is NoNo.
<fe><02><0a><31><38><32><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>It is the one who's placed\ndemons in your path.

<fe><02><0a><31><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The source of the trouble\nlies beyond here.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>We must confront it to\nprevent another Ragnarok...
<fe><02><0a><31><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>That's a lot to ask for\njust the two of us.
<fe><02><0a><31><38><34><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>You talk too much for\nyour own good, Familiar.
<fe><02><0a><31><38><34><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>That summon spell was in\nthe Sacred Tongue!
<fe><02><0a><31><38><34><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>She stands in the way\nof your mission.
<fe><02><0a><31><38><34><62><5f><30><30><33><33><00>Why must Riviera suffer due\nto the arrogance of the Magi?
<fe><02><09><65><30><37><5f><30><30><30><30><00>In the name of the gods,\npass judgment on Ursula.<fe><00><fe><02><09><65><30><37><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Open the gate to the Promised\nLand.
<fe><02><0a><31><38><31><61><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Enemy of Riviera,\nyour pain shall end.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><38><31><61><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Your rage shall be\nyour blessing here...
<fe><02><0a><31><39><32><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>So is that why it hasn't\nbeen ransacked?
<fe><02><0a><31><39><32><62><5f><30><30><32><31><00>See how the ornament\nsparkles in the sun?
<fe><02><0a><31><39><32><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>You're not expecting to\nfind treasure, are you?
<fe><02><0a><31><39><32><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>I'm sure you'll run into\nplenty of enemies though.
<fe><02><0a><31><39><33><62><5f><30><30><31><32><00>Ein, you're making too\nmany mistakes.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><39><33><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>A battle like this\nshouldn't take so long.

<fe><02><0a><31><39><33><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Hey! How about we polish\nit and sell it?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><31><39><33><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>...Of course, that may have\nto wait 'til later.

The resting place of
the Grim Angels that
lost their lives in
Ragnarok. Entry is
now prohibited.

A walkway at
Heaven's Gate made
of floating rocks,
leading to a cavern.

The stone stairway
where fallen angels
were tried.
It spirals up to
a cavern.

The stone steps
eventually lead
into a cavern.
Light gently seeps
through the cracks.

Where judgment used
to be passed on fallen
angels. Giant boulders
hang in the sky by
chains.

A path made of rocks
chained together.
The footing is shaky,
but they are seen all
over Heaven's Gate.

A nameless temple
in the southernmost
area of Heaven's Gate.
Its floor has cracked
over time.

The southernmost
portal of Heaven's
Gate. A barrier
prevents anyone
from passing.
<fe><02><0a><31><38><32><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Servants of Asgard, turn back.\nReturn from whence you came.

Ruins of a palace that
once held sacred
treasures, but was
destroyed during
Ragnarok.
<fe><02><0a><32><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>We really did get here\nin an instant!
<fe><02><0a><32><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Are we really going\nto search the castle?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><31><32><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>Maybe we shouldn't.\nIt might be dangerous...
<fe><02><0a><32><31><32><62><5f><30><30><32><30><00>I plan on keeping my\npromise to Ursula.

<fe><02><0a><32><31><32><62><5f><30><30><34><31><00>I think these herbs can\nbe used to make Potions.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><31><32><62><5f><30><30><34><32><00>With practice, I might\nbe able to make some.
<fe><02><0a><32><31><32><62><5f><30><30><34><34><00>It restores your health\nwhen you drink it.
<fe><02><0c><32><31><32><62><5f><30><30><35><39><5f><61><00>It restores your health\nwhen you drink it.
<fe><02><0a><32><31><32><62><5f><30><30><37><39><00>It may not be usable.\nThe blade's chipped...
<fe><02><0a><32><31><33><62><5f><30><30><31><35><00>Some enemies aim for\nnearby targets,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><31><33><62><5f><30><30><31><36><00>while others prefer to\nstrike from a distance.
<fe><02><0a><32><31><33><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>They might attack one\nof us, or all of us!
<fe><02><0a><32><31><33><62><5f><30><30><35><33><00>Either way, it makes\nour job a lot easier<a2><51>
<fe><02><0a><32><31><33><62><5f><30><30><35><34><00>We'll be counting on\nyou from now on, Ein.
<fe><02><0a><32><31><33><62><5f><30><30><35><39><00>Seeing how well you\nfought in battle...<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><31><33><62><5f><30><30><36><30><00>I believe we can trust\nyour judgment.
<fe><02><0a><32><31><33><62><5f><30><30><37><38><00>You never know what\nmight come in handy.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Just the three of us...\nYou think it's okay?

<fe><02><0a><32><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Well, if we wait for\nthe Elder's permission,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>we'll be old and wrinkly\nby the time we go.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><32><62><5f><30><30><31><33><00>But you know how to fight!\nWe'll be fine!
<fe><02><0a><32><32><32><62><5f><30><30><32><33><00>If you really think it'll\nbe okay, then I'll go.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><32><62><5f><30><30><33><30><00>I never expected to be\nattacked by a statue.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><32><62><5f><30><30><34><38><00>The lone team member is most\nprone to being attacked,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><32><32><62><5f><30><30><34><39><00>so choose carefully.
<fe><02><0a><32><32><32><62><5f><30><30><35><34><00>The head and one of the\nwings have fallen off.

<fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>No, it is said that
the Arcs created them<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>in the image of
the ancient demons.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Lina was reprimanded
once for suggesting<fe><00><fe><02><0a><32><32><33><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>that the statues
resemble the Arcs.
